name: fuzz-component-limit-flagship
description: Fuzz pbd297 (bot 3541163): the Nomad (flagship on the board from the start) pressed 'Produce Flagship (0)' in Warfare's build and placed a 2nd flagship (invariant units.within-component-limit). The original showed what is left in reinforcements but never refused it. Fix (bot fuzz-triage-1): UnitComponentLimit — the place_ handler, production.produce validate and its payload refuse a ship / mech with none left in reinforcements; options carry value.remaining. Here: Ral Nel's flagship is placed at 307, then producing another one there is refused (engine and press) and the board keeps one.
